messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: runtime-container-crashloop on gpu-pool/ded-nyc-1 (severity: P1). Detecting repeated container exit with SIGSEGV.

alice: seeing a spike in crashloop counts for runtime service across 3 nodes. Logs show segfault in a custom fused kernel path (kv_cache.cu). tossing this here so oncall can triage.

ben: thanks. can someone grab `kubectl describe` and pod logs for one of the failing pods? suspect it's the TRT fused-attn path we rolled last night.

carla: grabbing logs now. pod: runtime-gpu-7f6b9c on node gpu-ded-12. recent OOMs then segfaults. attaching tail: 
```
2026-02-20T09:12:03Z runtime: INFO serving model redwood-v2-ctr
2026-02-20T09:12:04Z cuda: WARN device 0 stopped responding, resetting
2026-02-20T09:12:04Z runtime: ERROR signal 11 at fused_kernels/kv_cache.cu:204
stack: 0x7fbc12c 0x7fb8a9...
2026-02-20T09:12:04Z runtime: container exited with code 139
```

dave: this looks like memory corruption in the fused kv path. we saw a similar pattern in canary when we enabled aggressive prefetch + trt quantization.

ben: can we confirm kernel/driver versions on that node and compare with healthy ones? run `nvidia-smi -q` and `uname -a`. also check if any host-level OOM or hardware ECC errors.

carla: nvidia-smi: driver 538.13, CUDA 12.1. healthy node gpu-ded-09 has same driver. dmesg contains: 
```
[ 5132.123456] NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 5132.123459] NVRM: RmInitAdapter failed, device minor number -1
[ 5132.123460] runtime[2731]: segfault at 7f1b000 ip 00007f... sp 00007ff... error 6 in libcudart.so
```

alice: customer impact: AcmeChat (dedicated pool shard on ded-nyc-1) reporting ~6% 500s, most due to container restart. A/B traffic shows fallback to hosted API for some requests but latency spikes.

ben: immediate mitigations: 1) cordon the three affected nodes to stop scheduling new pods. 2) scale down pool for canary workloads and drain non-critical pods. 3) enable model routing fallback to CPU/quantized variant for critical customer routes. 4) disable TensorRT fused kernels via env `RW_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNELS=1` in runtime config and roll a small canary.

dave: I pushed a canary with `RW_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNELS=1` to one replica in ded-nyc-1. container stayed up for 10m and processed requests successfully, no segfaults.

carla: collecting core dumps + gdb backtrace from the failing pod. here's short bt from gdb (resolved symbols): 
```
#0  0x00007fabcde in fused_kv::write_batch() at fused_kernels/kv_cache.cu:202
#1  0x00007fabcd1 in fused_attn::forward() at fused_kernels/fused_attn.cu:489
#2  0x0000555f123 in runtime::process_request()
```

alice: good repro path. dave, can you coordinate with infra to push a temporary rollback of the fused kernel change in the TRT lib? If not possible, keep the env flip for all critical shards and roll forward the patch later.

ben: infra: @infra-bot can you cordon nodes gpu-ded-10..12 and drain, then create a temporary nodepool with driver 535.x to test older driver matrix? prefer to avoid mass restarts while customers are impacted.

infra-bot: Acknowledged. Starting cordon+drain for gpu-ded-10,gpu-ded-11,gpu-ded-12. Creating replacement nodes: ded-nyc-1-temp-01..03 with driver 535.102. ETA ~8m.

carla: also pushing logs to S3 bucket s3://redwood-incident-dumps/3643000000/ for postmortem. grabbed `strace`, `ldd` on runtime binary, and nvml logs.

dave: quick note — the segfault happens after a `memcpy` from GPU to host during KV evict. suspect out-of-bounds index when sequence length is > 2048 with certain batch shapes. we'll add bounds checks in the fused kernel, but that's a code fix for later.

alice: immediate customer communication: notifying AcmeChat ops that we have mitigations (fallback + node cordon) and are investigating root cause. ETA for full restored capacity ~30-45m depending on node replacements.

ben: assigning oncall handoff — I'm on for next 25 minutes, then @carla will take over. Carla pls ack once you pick up the pager.

carla: taking over in 20m. will monitor the canary and ensure rollback env is applied to all critical shards. leaving notes here for postmortem: timeline, driver parity, fused kernel flag, affected model variants, core dumps location, customer impact numbers.

alice: thanks team. action items summary: 
- cordon/drain affected nodes (infra-bot)
- keep `RW_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNELS=1` on critical shards (dave)
- collect and upload cores + bt (carla)
- notify customers + update status page (alice)
- code fix (bounds check) for fused kv kernel (eng-ml backlog)

oncall-bot: Handoff note recorded. Next oncall: carla (starts 3643000900). Incident channel will remain open for 2h for monitoring. :white_check_mark:

ben: last check — error rate down to 1.2% since cordon+fallback. continuing to watch.

carla: ack, monitoring metrics: requests p95 restored to pre-incident for critical routes. will open a formal incident ticket and attach the artifacts.

incident-bot: Incident declared: ID INC-2026-3643. Postmortem owner: carla.

alice: closing loop here; will schedule postmortem meeting tomorrow. thanks all. :heart:
